inspection.method: Independent view_image review plus read-only RGBA measurement; PNG bytes unchanged.
inspection.rectMethod: Each visually isolated sprite: alpha > 10 bounds plus 2 px padding. Grid regions only isolate candidates; output rectangles are measured, not 512x512 cuts.
inspection.anchorMethod: Ground y = bottom edge of alpha > 127 silhouette. Stable horizontal origin = measured pink nose centroid x minus 180 source pixels. Anchor is relative to rect. Horizontal origin is an estimated body pivot, not a leg centroid.
inspection.background: RGBA has real transparency. Very faint residual alpha extends outside subject, hence thresholded bounds. Subject is near-opaque (max alpha 254).
inspection.characterConsistency: Pass: same warm-orange tabby, cream muzzle/chest/paw tips, brown stripes, pink nose, upright striped tail; source-scale silhouette heights vary about 4%.
inspection.gaitConsistency: Fail: frames 1, 3, 6 repeat a very similar near-foreleg support phase. The original order retracts, extends, then retracts the far foreleg without a full corresponding near-foreleg contact/passing cycle. Several real poses exist, but a complete coherent six-frame gait is absent.
inspection.loopDecision: Do not solve by repeating/reordering until labeled as a full walk. Await regenerated four-phase gait. No runtime sequence approved.
